use_case_summary: Embedding a low-latency IDE copilot into Buildsmith's internal dev tools. Primary requirements: deterministic tail latency for token streaming (<50ms target), model/version pinning across releases, burstable dedicated capacity for morning/evening peak developer sessions, retention controls and audit logs for code-related telemetry.
